org.souther-lang:souther-architecture-test 0.2.0 发布, Holds the checks whose population is the whole reactor, and nothing else — its compiled
        output, or its sources where the fact a check is about is written in them rather than kept
        in a class file. A check that reads compiled classes sees what has been built when it runs,
        so where it lives is what it measures: one living in the module it is about reads that
        module and passes over every module built after it, saying nothing about them while looking
        as though it did. A check that a module can answer on its own belongs in that module.

        The reactor had no such place. This is one: it depends on every other module and nothing
        depends on it, so Maven builds it last and every module's classes are there when its tests
        run. That every module is depended on is what the tests here assert of this pom's own
        dependencies, rather than something the build order would show — an omitted dependency takes
        an edge away, and the remaining edges go on sending this module to the end whenever one of
        them names a module written after the one that was forgotten.

        Nothing ships from here and there is no main source. The dependencies are test-scoped
        because that is what they are for: compiling and running these tests, and telling Maven what
        must be built before them.

org.souther-lang:souther-program-api-test 0.2.0 发布, Stands where an output outside souther-compiler stands. It depends on souther-compiler and on
        nothing else of this project, reads a checked program through the boundary meant for it, and
        holds that boundary to what it is for: a compiler is not something an output reads.

        Nothing ships from here. It exists because the property being kept — that an artifact of its
        own can consume a checked Souther program — is about what a separate artifact can compile
        against, and no test living inside souther-compiler is separate from it.
